<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bgGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9ADB7F"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#6EA95C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="btnGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9ADB7F"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#6EA95C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="160%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="8" stdDeviation="12" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.22"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bgGrad)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F9F9F9"/>

  <!-- subtle background circles -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="106" r="62" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.18"/>
  <circle cx="348" cy="126" r="86" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.12"/>
  <circle cx="320" cy="690" r="120" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.10"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="690" r="86" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.08"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="28" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#24262B">9:41</text>
    <rect x="316" y="18" width="22" height="11" rx="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#24262B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="318" y="20" width="17" height="7.3" rx="1.5" fill="#24262B"/>
    <rect x="339" y="21.5" width="1.4" height="4" rx="0.5" fill="#24262B"/>
    <circle cx="360" cy="23.5" r="3.1" fill="#24262B"/>
    <circle cx="368" cy="23.5" r="3.1" fill="#24262B"/>
    <circle cx="376" cy="23.5" r="3.1" fill="#24262B"/>
    <line x1="346" y1="20.5" x2="354" y2="20.5" stroke="#24262B" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.8"/>
    <line x1="346" y1="23" x2="352" y2="23" stroke="#24262B" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.8"/>
    <line x1="346" y1="25.5" x2="350" y2="25.5" stroke="#24262B" stroke-width="1.2" opacity="0.8"/>
    <rect x="356" y="18.5" width="12" height="11" rx="5.5" fill="none" stroke="#24262B" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="362" cy="24" r="2.5" fill="#24262B"/>
  </g>

  <!-- hero success icon -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <circle cx="195" cy="265" r="78" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="265" r="64" fill="url(#btnGrad)"/>
    <polyline points="165,264 186,285 229,242" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="384" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" font-weight="600" fill="#24262B">Order Success</text>
  <text x="195" y="416" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Your order has been placed successfully.</text>

  <!-- order summary card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="452" width="342" height="156" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="24" y="452" width="342" height="156" rx="20" fill="none" stroke="#E7E7E7"/>
    <text x="44" y="480" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#24262B">Order details</text>

    <circle cx="54" cy="520" r="20" fill="#A06AF9"/>
    <text x="54" y="525" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">M</text>

    <text x="84" y="515" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#24262B">Marcus Lee</text>
    <text x="84" y="534" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Order #KJH-204891 • Jun 14, 2026</text>

    <rect x="277" y="500" width="69" height="22" rx="11" fill="#A5F59C"/>
    <text x="311.5" y="515" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#24262B">PAID</text>

    <line x1="44" y1="554" x2="346" y2="554" stroke="#E7E7E7"/>
    <text x="44" y="576" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Total paid</text>
    <text x="346" y="576" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#24262B">$248.40</text>

    <text x="44" y="596" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Estimated delivery</text>
    <text x="346" y="596" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#24262B">Tue, Jun 18</text>
  </g>

  <!-- button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="36" y="642" width="318" height="56" rx="28" fill="url(#btnGrad)"/>
    <text x="195" y="676" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Back to home</text>
  </g>

  <!-- secondary actions -->
  <g>
    <rect x="52" y="714" width="126" height="40" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.96"/>
    <text x="115" y="739" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#24262B">Track order</text>

    <rect x="212" y="714" width="126" height="40" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.96"/>
    <text x="275" y="739" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#24262B">Share receipt</text>
  </g>

  <!-- supportive info row -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="54" cy="791" r="16" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.95"/>
    <polyline points="47,791 52,796 61,785" fill="none" stroke="#6EA95C" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="78" y="796" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Confirmation sent to marcus.lee@email.com</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="760" width="390" height="84" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.98"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="760" x2="390" y2="760" stroke="#E7E7E7"/>

    <!-- Home -->
    <g transform="translate(24,773)">
      <polygon points="14,3 2,13 26,13" fill="#5E6272"/>
      <rect x="8" y="13" width="12" height="12" rx="2" fill="#5E6272"/>
      <text x="14" y="39" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Home</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Orders -->
    <g transform="translate(106,773)">
      <rect x="4" y="5" width="22" height="18" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="8" y1="10" x2="22" y2="10" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="8" y1="15" x2="18" y2="15" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="15" y="39" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Orders</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Search -->
    <g transform="translate(188,773)">
      <circle cx="14" cy="11" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="19" y1="16" x2="25" y2="22" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="14" y="39" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Search</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Profile -->
    <g transform="translate(270,773)">
      <circle cx="15" cy="10" r="6" fill="#5E6272"/>
      <rect x="8" y="17" width="14" height="8" rx="4" fill="#5E6272"/>
      <text x="15" y="39" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Profile</text>
    </g>

    <!-- More -->
    <g transform="translate(341,773)">
      <circle cx="6" cy="11" r="2.2" fill="#5E6272"/>
      <circle cx="14" cy="11" r="2.2" fill="#5E6272"/>
      <circle cx="22" cy="11" r="2.2" fill="#5E6272"/>
      <text x="14" y="39" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">More</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
